narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a promotional clip for Taiwan's Public Television Service (PTS) year-end fundraising campaign. It features a young man interviewing a veteran ecological documentary director, Ke Jin-yuan, using wordplay and puns related to the director's name and documentary themes. The goal is to humanize the channel's contributors and encourage donations through a lighthearted yet meaningful dialogue about the weight of documentary work.
